newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: World War Two bomb kills two on Philippines beach.
newsitem.headline: World War Two bomb kills two on Philippines beach.

text.p: Two people were killed and six injured when a bomb believed dropped by Japanese planes during World War Two exploded on a beach north of Manila, police said on Wednesday.
The victims, employees of a bank having a barbeque on Monday at a beach resort in Bataan province, were cooking shellfish when the bomb buried in the sand below exploded, they said.
It was triggered by the heat from their charcoal stove.
The injured were being treated at a local hospital, police said.

Bataan was the scene of one of the bloodiest battles of the war in Asia. Its fall to the Japanese in 1941 signalled the defeat of Allied forces in the Philippines and paved the way for four years of Japanese rule.
